versions.label: v1 · Baseline
versions.note: The baseline proposals branch off. Close to the product, not identical: it is a prototype with fixtures, and in two screens it follows the spec where the shipped product has an open deviation (B-187, B-191).

versions.label: v2 · Backup host
versions.note: One named stand-in who can start the Zoom room when the owner is away, the join guarantee stated under it, and a warning when nobody can start the meeting — on the create form as well as the meeting view, since the ops checklist it replaces is handed to the owner while the meeting is being made.

changes.summary: Backup host and the join guarantee
Warns when nobody can start the meeting
Alternative hosts in the create form
The join guarantee stated at creation

versions.label: v3 · Week-view slot click
versions.note: A slot click draws the draft and asks Create meeting / Cancel before the form opens, and a click on a past slot says why nothing happened instead of being swallowed.

changes.summary: Draws the slot and asks, instead of opening the form
Create meeting / Cancel before the form opens
A past slot says why nothing happened
